system.description: Once per encounter, you can designate a single target that you have Aimed at and is not within Point-Blank Range. When making a ranged attack roll against that target, the target is denied its Dexterity bonus to their Reflex Defense when determining the effect of your attack.

prerequisite.text: Draw a Bead talent, Precision Shot talent, and Sniper feat
